    "def beam_update(self, tokens: Tensor, logits: Tensor, sum_logprobs: Tensor) -> Tuple[Tensor, bool]:\n",
    "    if tokens.shape[0] % self.beam_size != 0:\n",
    "        raise ValueError(f\"{tokens.shape}[0] % {self.beam_size} != 0\")\n",
    "\n",
    "    n_audio = tokens.shape[0] // self.beam_size\n",
    "    if self.finished_sequences is None:  \n",
    "        self.finished_sequences = [{} for _ in range(n_audio)]\n",
    "\n",
    "    logprobs = F.log_softmax(logits.float(), dim=-1)\n",
    "    next_tokens, source_indices, finished_sequences = [], [], []\n",
    "    for i in range(n_audio):\n",
    "        scores, sources, finished = {}, {}, {}\n",
    "\n",
    "        # å¯èƒ½æ€§ã®ã‚ã‚‹å€™è£œã®ç´¯ç©å¯¾æ•°ç¢ºçŽ‡ã‚’è¨ˆç®—\n",
    "        for j in range(self.beam_size):\n",
    "            idx = i * self.beam_size + j\n",
    "            prefix = tokens[idx].tolist()\n",
    "            for logprob, token in zip(*logprobs[idx].topk(self.beam_size + 1)):\n",
    "                new_logprob = (sum_logprobs[idx] + logprob).item()\n",
    "                sequence = tuple(prefix + [token.item()])\n",
    "                candidates.append(sequence)\n",
    "                scores[sequence] = new_logprob\n",
    "                sources[sequence] = idx\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "        # å€™è£œã‚’ãƒ©ãƒ³ã‚¯ä»˜ã‘ã—ã€å„ã‚ªãƒ¼ãƒ‡ã‚£ã‚ªã®ãƒ“ãƒ¼ãƒ ãƒ»ã‚µã‚¤ã‚ºãƒ»ã‚·ãƒ¼ã‚±ãƒ³ã‚¹ã®ä¸Šä½ã‚’ã‚­ãƒ¼ãƒ—\n",
    "        saved = 0\n",
    "        for sequence in sorted(scores, key=scores.get, reverse=True):\n",
    "            candidate_text = tokenizer.decode(list(sequence))\n",
    "            \n",
    "            # # å‚·ç—…è€…ã®ç¢ºçŽ‡\n",
    "            # if \"å‚·ç—…è€…\" in candidate_text:\n",
    "            #     scores[sequence]  += 10\n",
    "            \n",
    "            # if \"å‘¨å›²\" in candidate_text:\n",
    "            #     scores[sequence]  += 10\n",
    "            \n",
    "\n",
    "                \n",
    "            if sequence[-1] == self.eot:\n",
    "                finished[sequence] = scores[sequence]\n",
    "            else:\n",
    "                sum_logprobs[len(next_tokens)] = scores[sequence]\n",
    "                next_tokens.append(sequence)\n",
    "                source_indices.append(sources[sequence])\n",
    "\n",
    "                saved += 1\n",
    "                if saved == self.beam_size:\n",
    "                    break\n",
    "\n",
    "        finished_sequences.append(finished)\n",
    "\n",
    "    tokens = torch.tensor(next_tokens, device=tokens.device)\n",
    "    self.inference.rearrange_kv_cache(source_indices)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # add newly finished sequences to self.finished_sequences\n",
    "    assert len(self.finished_sequences) == len(finished_sequences)\n",
    "    for previously_finished, newly_finished in zip(\n",
    "        self.finished_sequences, finished_sequences\n",
    "    ):\n",
    "        for seq in sorted(newly_finished, key=newly_finished.get, reverse=True):\n",
    "            if len(previously_finished) >= self.max_candidates:\n",
    "                break  # the candidate list is full\n",
    "            previously_finished[seq] = newly_finished[seq]\n",
    "\n",
    "    # mark as completed if all audio has enough number of samples\n",
    "    completed = all(\n",
    "        len(sequences) >= self.max_candidates\n",
    "        for sequences in self.finished_sequences\n",
    "    )\n",
    "    return tokens, completed\n",
    "\n",
    "# Replace the original update method with the custom one\n",
    "BeamSearchDecoder.update = beam_update\n"

    "    nyquist = 0.5 * sr\n",

    "model_name =\"alabnii/jmedroberta-base-sentencepiece\"\n",
    "tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(model_name)\n",
    "model = AutoModel.from_pretrained(model_name)\n",
    "\n",
    "def get_token_embeddings(text):\n",
    "    # ãƒ†ã‚­ã‚¹ãƒˆã‚’ãƒˆãƒ¼ã‚¯ãƒ³åŒ–ã—ãƒ†ãƒ³ã‚½ãƒ«åŒ–ï¼ˆæœ€å¤§é•·ã¯é©å®œèª¿æ•´ï¼‰\n",
    "    inputs = tokenizer(text, return_tensors=\"pt\", truncation=True, max_length=512)\n",
    "    with torch.no_grad():\n",
    "        outputs = model(**inputs)\n",
    "    # æœ€çµ‚å±¤ã®éš ã‚ŒçŠ¶æ…‹ã‚’å–å¾— (shape: [1, seq_length, hidden_size])\n",
    "    embeddings = outputs.last_hidden_state.squeeze(0).numpy()  # (seq_length, hidden_size)\n",
    "    # ãƒˆãƒ¼ã‚¯ãƒ³IDã‚’æ–‡å­—åˆ—ã«å¤‰æ›\n",
    "    tokens = tokenizer.convert_ids_to_tokens(inputs[\"input_ids\"].squeeze(0))\n",
    "    return tokens, embeddings\n",
    "\n",

    "correct_text = \"å‚·ç—…è€…ç™ºè¦‹\"#ã€å‘¨å›²ã®å®‰å…¨è‰¯ã—ã€æ„ŸæŸ“é˜²å¾¡ã«é…æ…®ã—ã¾ã™\"\n",

    "\n",
    "# å„æ–‡ç« ã®ãƒˆãƒ¼ã‚¯ãƒ³ã¨åŸ‹ã‚è¾¼ã¿ã‚’å–å¾—\n",
    "tokens_correct, emb_correct = get_token_embeddings(correct_text)\n",
    "tokens_trans, emb_trans = get_token_embeddings(transcription)\n",
    "\n",
    "# å„ãƒˆãƒ¼ã‚¯ãƒ³é–“ã®ã‚³ã‚µã‚¤ãƒ³é¡žä¼¼åº¦è¡Œåˆ—ã‚’è¨ˆç®—\n",

    "import difflib\n",
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "\n",
    "# ãƒ¬ãƒ¼ãƒ™ãƒ³ã‚·ãƒ¥ã‚¿ã‚¤ãƒ³è·é›¢ï¼ˆç·¨é›†è·é›¢ï¼‰ã‚’è¨ˆç®—ã™ã‚‹é–¢æ•°\n",
    "def levenshtein_distance(s, t):\n",
    "    m, n = len(s), len(t)\n",
    "    dp = [[0]*(n+1) for _ in range(m+1)]\n",
    "    for i in range(m+1):\n",
    "        dp[i][0] = i\n",
    "    for j in range(n+1):\n",
    "        dp[0][j] = j\n",
    "    for i in range(1, m+1):\n",
    "        for j in range(1, n+1):\n",
    "            cost = 0 if s[i-1] == t[j-1] else 1\n",
    "            dp[i][j] = min(dp[i-1][j] + 1,      # å‰Šé™¤\n",
    "                           dp[i][j-1] + 1,      # æŒ¿å…¥\n",
    "                           dp[i-1][j-1] + cost) # ç½®æ›\n",
    "    return dp[m][n]\n",
    "\n",
    "# æ­£ã—ã„æ–‡ç« ã¨ Whisper ã®æ–‡å­—èµ·ã“ã—çµæžœï¼ˆä¾‹ï¼‰\n",
    "correct_text = \"å‚·ç—…è€…ç™ºè¦‹ã€å‘¨å›²ã®å®‰å…¨è‰¯ã—ã€æ„ŸæŸ“é˜²å¾¡ã«é…æ…®ã—ã¾ã™\"\n",
    "transcription = \"1åˆ†å¾Œäººå½¢æŸµåœå‘¨å›²ã®å®‰å®šã‚’ã—ã€æ›ç®—å·¥å…·ã«é…æ…®ã—ã¾ã™\"\n",
    "\n",
    "# difflib ã‚’ç”¨ã„ã¦é¡žä¼¼åº¦ï¼ˆ0ã€œ1ã®å€¤ï¼‰ã‚’è¨ˆç®—\n",
    "sm = difflib.SequenceMatcher(None, correct_text, transcription)\n",
    "similarity_ratio = sm.ratio()\n",
    "\n",
    "# ãƒ¬ãƒ¼ãƒ™ãƒ³ã‚·ãƒ¥ã‚¿ã‚¤ãƒ³è·é›¢ã‚’è¨ˆç®—ã—ã€æ­£è¦åŒ–ã—ã¦ã€Œæ­£è§£çŽ‡ã€ã‚’ç®—å‡ºï¼ˆ1ã«è¿‘ã„ã»ã©è‰¯ã„ï¼‰\n",
    "edit_distance = levenshtein_distance(correct_text, transcription)\n",
    "normalized_accuracy = 1 - edit_distance / max(len(correct_text), len(transcription))\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"SequenceMatcher Similarity:\", similarity_ratio)\n",
    "print(\"Edit Distance:\", edit_distance)\n",
    "print(\"Normalized Accuracy:\", normalized_accuracy)\n",
    "\n",
    "# çµæžœã‚’æ£’ã‚°ãƒ©ãƒ•ã§è¡¨ç¤ºï¼ˆå€¤ã¯0ï½ž1ã®ç¯„å›²ï¼‰\n",
    "metrics = ['SequenceMatcher Similarity', 'Normalized Accuracy']\n",
    "values = [similarity_ratio, normalized_accuracy]\n",
    "\n",
    "plt.figure(figsize=(6,4))\n",
    "plt.bar(metrics, values, color=['skyblue', 'salmon'])\n",
    "plt.ylim(0, 1)\n",
    "plt.ylabel('Score (0ï½ž1)')\n",

    "from whisper.decoding import BeamSearchDecoder\n",
    "from typing import Tuple, List\n",
    "import torch\n",
    "import torch.nn.functional as F\n",
    "from torch import Tensor\n",
    "from whisper.tokenizer import get_tokenizer\n",
    "import pandas as pd\n",
    "import logging\n",
    "import whisper\n",
    "from whisper.decoding import GreedyDecoder\n",
    "from typing import Tuple\n",
    "import torch\n",
    "import torch.nn.functional as F\n",
    "from torch import Tensor\n",
    "from torch.distributions import Categorical\n",
    "\n",
    "seq_logits = []\n",
    "def update(self, tokens: Tensor, logits: Tensor, sum_logprobs: Tensor) -> Tuple[Tensor, bool]:\n",
    "    temperature = self.temperature\n",
    "    seq_logits.append(logits)\n",
    "    if temperature == 0:\n",
    "        next_tokens = logits.argmax(dim=-1)\n",
    "    else:\n",
    "        next_tokens = Categorical(logits=logits / temperature).sample()\n",
    "\n",
    "    logprobs = F.log_softmax(logits.float(), dim=-1)\n",
    "    current_logprobs = logprobs[torch.arange(logprobs.shape[0]), next_tokens]\n",
    "    sum_logprobs += current_logprobs * (tokens[:, -1] != self.eot)\n",
    "\n",
    "    next_tokens[tokens[:, -1] == self.eot] = self.eot\n",
    "    tokens = torch.cat([tokens, next_tokens[:, None]], dim=-1)\n",
    "\n",
    "    completed = (tokens[:, -1] == self.eot).all()\n",
    "    return tokens, completed\n",
    "\n",
    "GreedyDecoder.update = update"

    "tokenizer = get_tokenizer(multilingual=True, language=\"ja\", task=\"transcribe\")\n",

    "def beam_update(self, tokens: Tensor, logits: Tensor, sum_logprobs: Tensor) -> Tuple[Tensor, bool]:\n",
    "    if tokens.shape[0] % self.beam_size != 0:\n",
    "        raise ValueError(f\"{tokens.shape}[0] % {self.beam_size} != 0\")\n",
    "\n",
    "    n_audio = tokens.shape[0] // self.beam_size\n",
    "    if self.finished_sequences is None:  \n",
    "        self.finished_sequences = [{} for _ in range(n_audio)]\n",
    "\n",
    "    logprobs = F.log_softmax(logits.float(), dim=-1)\n",
    "    next_tokens, source_indices, finished_sequences = [], [], []\n",
    "    for i in range(n_audio):\n",
    "        scores, sources, finished = {}, {}, {}\n",
    "\n",
    "        # å¯èƒ½æ€§ã®ã‚ã‚‹å€™è£œã®ç´¯ç©å¯¾æ•°ç¢ºçŽ‡ã‚’è¨ˆç®—\n",
    "        for j in range(self.beam_size):\n",
    "            idx = i * self.beam_size + j\n",
    "            prefix = tokens[idx].tolist()\n",
    "            for logprob, token in zip(*logprobs[idx].topk(self.beam_size + 1)):\n",
    "                new_logprob = (sum_logprobs[idx] + logprob).item()\n",
    "                sequence = tuple(prefix + [token.item()])\n",
    "                candidates.append(sequence)\n",
    "                scores[sequence] = new_logprob\n",
    "                sources[sequence] = idx\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "        # å€™è£œã‚’ãƒ©ãƒ³ã‚¯ä»˜ã‘ã—ã€å„ã‚ªãƒ¼ãƒ‡ã‚£ã‚ªã®ãƒ“ãƒ¼ãƒ ãƒ»ã‚µã‚¤ã‚ºãƒ»ã‚·ãƒ¼ã‚±ãƒ³ã‚¹ã®ä¸Šä½ã‚’ã‚­ãƒ¼ãƒ—\n",
    "        saved = 0\n",
    "        for sequence in sorted(scores, key=scores.get, reverse=True):\n",
    "            candidate_text = tokenizer.decode(list(sequence))\n",
    "            \n",
    "            # # å‚·ç—…è€…ã®ç¢ºçŽ‡\n",
    "            # if \"å‚·ç—…è€…\" in candidate_text:\n",
    "            #     scores[sequence]  += 10\n",
    "            \n",
    "            # if \"å‘¨å›²\" in candidate_text:\n",
    "            #     scores[sequence]  += 10\n",
    "            \n",
    "\n",
    "                \n",
    "            if sequence[-1] == self.eot:\n",
    "                finished[sequence] = scores[sequence]\n",
    "            else:\n",
    "                sum_logprobs[len(next_tokens)] = scores[sequence]\n",
    "                next_tokens.append(sequence)\n",
    "                source_indices.append(sources[sequence])\n",
    "\n",
    "                saved += 1\n",
    "                if saved == self.beam_size:\n",
    "                    break\n",
    "\n",
    "        finished_sequences.append(finished)\n",
    "\n",
    "    tokens = torch.tensor(next_tokens, device=tokens.device)\n",
    "    self.inference.rearrange_kv_cache(source_indices)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # add newly finished sequences to self.finished_sequences\n",
    "    assert len(self.finished_sequences) == len(finished_sequences)\n",
    "    for previously_finished, newly_finished in zip(\n",
    "        self.finished_sequences, finished_sequences\n",
    "    ):\n",
    "        for seq in sorted(newly_finished, key=newly_finished.get, reverse=True):\n",
    "            if len(previously_finished) >= self.max_candidates:\n",
    "                break  # the candidate list is full\n",
    "            previously_finished[seq] = newly_finished[seq]\n",
    "\n",
    "    # mark as completed if all audio has enough number of samples\n",
    "    completed = all(\n",
    "        len(sequences) >= self.max_candidates\n",
    "        for sequences in self.finished_sequences\n",
    "    )\n",
    "    return tokens, completed\n",
    "\n",
    "# Replace the original update method with the custom one\n",
    "BeamSearchDecoder.update = beam_update\n"

    "def high_pass_filter(audio, sr, cutoff=100, order=5):\n",
    "    nyquist = 0.5 * sr\n",

    "import difflib\n",
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "\n",
    "# ãƒ¬ãƒ¼ãƒ™ãƒ³ã‚·ãƒ¥ã‚¿ã‚¤ãƒ³è·é›¢ï¼ˆç·¨é›†è·é›¢ï¼‰ã‚’è¨ˆç®—ã™ã‚‹é–¢æ•°\n",
    "def levenshtein_distance(s, t):\n",
    "    m, n = len(s), len(t)\n",
    "    dp = [[0]*(n+1) for _ in range(m+1)]\n",
    "    for i in range(m+1):\n",
    "        dp[i][0] = i\n",
    "    for j in range(n+1):\n",
    "        dp[0][j] = j\n",
    "    for i in range(1, m+1):\n",
    "        for j in range(1, n+1):\n",
    "            cost = 0 if s[i-1] == t[j-1] else 1\n",
    "            dp[i][j] = min(dp[i-1][j] + 1,      # å‰Šé™¤\n",
    "                           dp[i][j-1] + 1,      # æŒ¿å…¥\n",
    "                           dp[i-1][j-1] + cost) # ç½®æ›\n",
    "    return dp[m][n]\n",
    "\n",
    "# æ­£ã—ã„æ–‡ç« ã¨ Whisper ã®æ–‡å­—èµ·ã“ã—çµæžœï¼ˆä¾‹ï¼‰\n",
    "correct_text = \"å‚·ç—…è€…ç™ºè¦‹ã€å‘¨å›²ã®å®‰å…¨è‰¯ã—ã€æ„ŸæŸ“é˜²å¾¡ã«é…æ…®ã—ã¾ã™\"\n",
    "transcription = \"1åˆ†å¾Œäººå½¢æŸµåœå‘¨å›²ã®å®‰å®šã‚’ã—ã€æ›ç®—å·¥å…·ã«é…æ…®ã—ã¾ã™\"\n",
    "\n",
    "# difflib ã‚’ç”¨ã„ã¦é¡žä¼¼åº¦ï¼ˆ0ã€œ1ã®å€¤ï¼‰ã‚’è¨ˆç®—\n",
    "sm = difflib.SequenceMatcher(None, correct_text, transcription)\n",
    "similarity_ratio = sm.ratio()\n",
    "\n",
    "# ãƒ¬ãƒ¼ãƒ™ãƒ³ã‚·ãƒ¥ã‚¿ã‚¤ãƒ³è·é›¢ã‚’è¨ˆç®—ã—ã€æ­£è¦åŒ–ã—ã¦ã€Œæ­£è§£çŽ‡ã€ã‚’ç®—å‡ºï¼ˆ1ã«è¿‘ã„ã»ã©è‰¯ã„ï¼‰\n",
    "edit_distance = levenshtein_distance(correct_text, transcription)\n",
    "normalized_accuracy = 1 - edit_distance / max(len(correct_text), len(transcription))\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"SequenceMatcher Similarity:\", similarity_ratio)\n",
    "print(\"Edit Distance:\", edit_distance)\n",
    "print(\"Normalized Accuracy:\", normalized_accuracy)\n",
    "\n",
    "# çµæžœã‚’æ£’ã‚°ãƒ©ãƒ•ã§è¡¨ç¤ºï¼ˆå€¤ã¯0ï½ž1ã®ç¯„å›²ï¼‰\n",
    "metrics = ['SequenceMatcher Similarity', 'Normalized Accuracy']\n",
    "values = [similarity_ratio, normalized_accuracy]\n",

   "source": [
    "from whisper.decoding import BeamSearchDecoder\n",
    "from typing import Tuple, List\n",
    "import torch\n",
    "import torch.nn.functional as F\n",
    "from torch import Tensor\n",
    "from whisper.tokenizer import get_tokenizer\n",
    "import pandas as pd\n",
    "import logging\n",
    "import whisper\n",
    "from whisper.decoding import GreedyDecoder\n",
    "from typing import Tuple\n",
    "import torch\n",
    "import torch.nn.functional as F\n",
    "from torch import Tensor\n",
    "from torch.distributions import Categorical\n",
    "\n",
    "seq_logits = []\n",
    "def update(self, tokens: Tensor, logits: Tensor, sum_logprobs: Tensor) -> Tuple[Tensor, bool]:\n",
    "    temperature = self.temperature\n",
    "    seq_logits.append(logits)\n",
    "    if temperature == 0:\n",
    "        next_tokens = logits.argmax(dim=-1)\n",
    "    else:\n",
    "        next_tokens = Categorical(logits=logits / temperature).sample()\n",
    "\n",
    "    logprobs = F.log_softmax(logits.float(), dim=-1)\n",
    "    current_logprobs = logprobs[torch.arange(logprobs.shape[0]), next_tokens]\n",
    "    sum_logprobs += current_logprobs * (tokens[:, -1] != self.eot)\n",
    "\n",
    "    next_tokens[tokens[:, -1] == self.eot] = self.eot\n",
    "    tokens = torch.cat([tokens, next_tokens[:, None]], dim=-1)\n",
    "\n",
    "    completed = (tokens[:, -1] == self.eot).all()\n",
    "    return tokens, completed\n",
    "\n",
    "GreedyDecoder.update = update"
   ]
